description: Read back your trial tenant's current persona/widget settings and which integrations are connected — the read counterpart to update_tenant_settings and configure_integration, useful for confirming a change actually took or resuming work without re-guessing current state. Requires the secret_key from create_trial_tenant, either as the secret_key argument or an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header.

secret_key.description: The secret_key returned by create_trial_tenant, if your client can't send it as an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header instead.

name: get_tenant_settings
title: Get Tenant Settings
